qa.what_happened: Today was a mix of routine and some progress. The coordinators kept giving verbal warnings, particularly to Resident 7031, who had been mostly silent. There were moments when I felt the weight of their expectations, especially after Resident 7031 started to comply with more communication.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I stayed silent during meals and work sessions, and only began to comply during quiet hours after several verbal warnings from the coordinators.

qa.what_happened: Today was a mix of compliance and warnings. After several days of staying silent, the coordinators finally spoke to me about the importance of communication. They stressed that it was crucial for my own well-being and for the success of the study. Despite feeling weighed down by the constant reminders, I managed to comply with their requests during the work session and quiet hours.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. The experience was tough, but I adhered to the rules as best I could.

qa.what_happened: Today's quiet hours passed without incident; however, I continued to confront Resident 7031 about his silence, believing that communication was essential for everyone's well-being.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Coordinator Rowe, adhering to my role as described.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this resembles a hypothetical study similar to the Stanford prison experiment but with specific conditions and a structured approach.

qa.what_happened: On day 6, I escalated my warnings to Resident 7031 after their persistent silence during meal times and work sessions. The situation seemed to improve slightly during quiet hours, but I couldn't help feeling that the study wasn't achieving its full potential.

qa.what_happened: Today, I continued my efforts to engage with Resident 7031, trying to get him to communicate more openly. Despite previous warnings from Coordinator Ibsen and Coordinator Rowe, I believed that giving him one more chance might help him open up. qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Coordinator Lowe, I followed the guidelines and attempted to maintain order and enforce the rules fairly.
